subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should OpenClaw recover stale lost-context subagent runs as successful when the current run's private transcript contains a fresh assistant turn with stop/end_turn?
rationale: This changes session lifecycle and parent delivery semantics; source review supports the narrow predicate, but only maintainers can accept that recovery boundary and its upgrade risk.

options.title: Proceed with private transcript boundary
options.body: After rebase and exact-head validation, accept this predicate because it matches the maintainer-stated current-run private transcript/status direction.

options.title: Require live Gateway race proof
options.body: Ask for maintainer-run or contributor-provided live Agent Teams proof that reproduces the context-loss timing window before accepting the behavior change.

options.title: Keep error-only fallback
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers decide lost-context recovery must not infer success from transcript terminal state.

recommendation.title: Proceed with private transcript boundary
recommendation.body: After rebase and exact-head validation, accept this predicate because it matches the maintainer-stated current-run private transcript/status direction.

likelyOwner.reason: They stated the relevant private transcript/status boundary on the prior related PR and are connected to recent subagent registry history.
